title: Chapter 19 The Real Long River Of Time And Space
content:
Chapter 19 The Real Long River Of Time And Space

With such a great opportunity, can we stop here?

And just as everyone was discouraged, another buzzing sound suddenly rang out.

boom!

With a loud bang, the next moment, countless practitioners surrounded by the giant city were suddenly shocked.

I saw a stream of spiritual energy that was so rich that it was unimaginable that it surged out of the giant city.

In just a moment, the environment outside the giant city was like a legendary holy land.

Feeling the surrounding environment and the giant city where spiritual energy is still gushing out, everyone is so shocked that they can't even close their mouths.

"Miracles, miracles!"

Suddenly, everyone became cheering.

Seeing this scene, Ji Wuhui and others in the void were immediately ecstatic.

Even if they were beaten to death, they would never have thought that this mysterious giant city would become like this.

It was simply an unexpected surprise.

They knew that the outer cities they expanded were about to become sky-high prices.

Not daring to hesitate, the few people hurriedly left to prepare.

As for entering the city, I can only talk about it later.

Anyway, the city is here, can we still run away?

At the same time, the drastic changes here instantly attracted the attention of almost everyone in the Tianxuan World.

Because the spiritual energy is too rich, it is still spreading, almost changing the cultivation environment of the entire Tianxuan world.

And now, it continues.

"I want to enter the city, too!"

"And I, and I."

"This is a million spirit stones, let me in first."

At this time, some practitioners who could take out one million spirit stones reacted and immediately stepped forward and said excitedly.

But this is what it looks like outside the giant city, what about inside the giant city?

I can even think of it with my butt and know it is absolutely extraordinary.

Then everyone stepped forward to pay the fee.

Seeing this, the two brothers of the Zhang family guarding the city looked at each other and said indifferently: "Don't be anxious, don't be anxious, line up first."

After a while, everyone lined up obediently.

Haven't you seen the outcome of the person in the Divine Palace before?

If you want to use force here, then forget it.

Just abide by the rules.

After handing the ring containing millions of spirit stones on it, the two brothers of the Zhang family took a look and nodded, "Go in."

Hearing this, the man looked happy and rushed in.

This errand for receiving city expenses was indeed provided by Lu Daosheng.

The original intention is to provide some wealth to the citizens.

But unexpectedly, everyone in the deserted city looked down on me, and only the two brothers of the Zhang family volunteered to come.

And at this time, the city.

Nangong Yu supported his grandfather and looked at the scene in front of him, his eyes almost glaring out.

I saw that the city seemed to be in a fairyland, with lofts full of supreme aura, streams emitting rich vitality, and giant trees and tall towers that were far away in the sky and seemed to be close to me.

Is this the deserted city?

"Grandpa, is this a dream?"

Nangong Yu looked at the scene in front of him and said in a daze.

Hearing his grandson's words, Nangong Fang turned around and said with a serious expression: "Ayu, go back and notify the clan immediately and let all the talented people in the clan come here."

Hearing this, Nangong Yu nodded.

"Then grandpa, you,?"

Nangong Fang looked at the places where the giant trees spread across the sky in the distance and said solemnly: "I'll go and visit the master of this supreme city."

Hearing this, Nangong Yu's pupils shrank sharply.

Yes, this city is not a masterless thing. The person guarding the city gate just now said that it was their city lord who asked them to do it.

So this giant city called the deserted city has its owner.

Then what kind of person should the owner of such a supreme city that cannot be described in words?

"Grandpa, you, be careful."

"Don't worry, I know that kind of character is probably far beyond our imagination."

Nangong Fang nodded and was about to leave immediately.

And at this moment, a message poured into my mind.

To be precise, all those who entered the deserted city received this message.

Those who enter the deserted city must abide by the rules and orders of the deserted city.

Do not fight in a military way.

Don't make noises loudly.

Do not fly high altitudes.

......

Violators will be expelled and will never enter the deserted city again. In severe cases, they will be executed on the spot.

Suddenly, dozens of rules entered everyone's mind.

Especially the last sentence, it was executed on the spot.

Everyone had no intention of contempt.

Look at the environment here, it doesn’t look like a joke.

"Grandpa, take care of yourself."

After hearing these rules, Nangong Yu spoke to his grandfather, then turned around and left.

Looking at the grandson's departure, Nangong Fang turned around and looked towards the center of the city, his eyes became firmer, and then he took big strides towards the city lord's mansion.

.........

At this time, the city lord's mansion was in the city.

In a boudoir with a little chill.

Lu Xue sat at the head of the bed, as if she had already cried into tears.

She never expected that her father would become that kind of person.

After not coming back for three hundred years, there is a new woman around you.

How could she accept this?

And at this moment, a squeak.

The door is open.

Lu Daosheng pushed the door open and left.

"go out!"

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue wiped her tears and said fiercely.

Seeing his daughter's attitude towards him, Lu Daosheng felt extremely uncomfortable. This was the first time Lu Xue treated him like this.

Behind Lu Daosheng, Gu Chen suddenly appeared.

"City Lord, sorry, Xiaoxue was in seclusion when I came before, so I haven't explained it to you yet."

Gu Chen spoke with apology in his tone.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and said, "I'd better explain it myself."

"Explanation? What's there to explain? Three hundred years, do you know how I lived these three hundred years?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Lu Xue's eyes were filled with tears, and her tone was full of dissatisfaction and grievance.

"Oh, Xiaoxue, Dad didn't expect it to be like this, that's how it is."

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng quickly explained the activating of the Time and Space God Tower to Lu Xue.

Because the time and space divine tower was activated, the time and space flow rate with the outside world changed, which led to three hundred years of spending in the deserted city.

In fact, it was only a month before the outside world.

As for Ouyang Yanqing's identity, it is better explained.

A friend I just met came to Huangcheng as a guest.

After hearing Lu Daosheng's explanation, Lu Xue stopped crying.

"Dad, didn't you lie to me?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng said seriously: "Dad never lie. At that time, space and flow rate, you can feel it."

Then Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand and slashed into the void. Suddenly, a huge and illusory river of time and space was captured by Lu Daosheng.

The endless laws of time and space are flowing continuously, and the aura of the Great Dao extends for thousands of miles.

As the long river of time and space magnifies, the section of the long river of time and space where the deserted city is located is a little longer than usual.

On the side, Gu Chen was already stunned.

The city lord is really a god.

Lu Xue doesn't understand these things, but she also has her mouth wide open.

"How is it, Xiaoxue, do you believe in your father now?"

Hearing this, Lu Xuemu nodded in a daze.

And at this moment, an angry shout filled with endless pressure suddenly rang out.

"Who dares to interfere with the operation of the long river of time and space without wanting to live anymore?!"

The next moment, an energy filled with the power of time and space was flowing up the long river of time and space and galloping down the river bank, and the target was Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this scene, Gu Chen's face looked extremely shocked.

"City Lord, is this true long river of time and space?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng just smiled and did not answer.

Seeing this, Gu Chen stopped talking.

The city lord is so awesome, he no longer knows how to describe it.

It is rumored that some powerful people with great strength can use the power of the long river of time and space to fight against the enemy or practice, and those strong people are just the phantoms of the long river of time and space to use.

After all, its original body is not a common thing.

That is the long river of time and space!

As long as it is slightly abnormal, the time and space of the entire world will be affected.

Now, in order to explain to his daughter, the city lord actually pulled the body of the long river of time and space directly over.

On the side, looking at the power of time and space born towards Lu Dao, Lu Xue's face turned pale. There was no way, the gap in strength was too big.

The other party is definitely not something Lu Xue can fight against now.

Of course, with Lu Daosheng here, Lu Xue will not have any trouble, and she will not even have any feelings.

And all of this was naturally done by Lu Daosheng on purpose.

Sure enough, the scared Lu Xue suddenly rushed into Lu Daosheng's arms.

Lu Daosheng, who succeeded in the conspiracy, smiled and waved his hand, and the power of time and space dissipated directly.

"Um?"

The voices of doubt sounded from the long river of time and space.

The next moment, an illusory figure slowly emerged from the upstream of the long river of time and space.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's appearance, the phantom was extremely puzzled.

Looking at the entire Hongmeng Universe, he should know all the creatures that can fight against him, so why is the person in front of him so unfamiliar?

"you,,"

The phantom was about to speak, when Lu Daosheng immediately released a trace of his own aura. Of course, this aura isolated Gu Chen and Lu Xue, because they might not be able to stand it.

Feeling Lu Daosheng's aura, the phantom was immediately panicked and actually knelt down directly at Lu Daosheng.

"Boss of Destiny, the villain has no idea about Mount Tai! The villain will leave now, leave now."

Then, he saw the phantom leaving here as if he was running away.

In the room, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, and waved his hand.

The long river of time and space disappeared suddenly.
